title: Outstandingly Crisp Thai Chicken Nam Prik
description: A grassy and crisp Thai dish featuring vanilla bean paste, perfect for a weeknight dinner, made in a Dutch oven and served as a nam prik.
instructions: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and bruised lemon grass to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Thai bird eye chilies to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and vanilla bean paste to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer, uncovered, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the chicken and sauce in individual bowls, garnished with additional lemon grass and chilies if desired.
